query: Which operational saturation criteria should we use (e.g., no new high-level themes across three successive coding passes) and how will we document stopping rules?

response.query: Which operational saturation criteria should we use (e.g., no new high-level themes across three successive coding passes) and how will we document stopping rules?
response.answer: Use no new high-level themes after three coding passes as saturation criteria. Document stopping rules in a detailed report with specifics on coding pass numbers and theme emergence.
